annotation.title_clean: Ordonnance n° 2021-443 du 14 avril 2021 relative au régime de responsabilité pénale applicable en cas de circulation d'un véhicule à délégation de conduite et à ses conditions d'utilisation
annotation.title_en: Ordinance No. 2021-443 of 14 April 2021 on the criminal liability regime applicable to the circulation of a vehicle with driving delegation and its conditions of use
annotation.venue: Légifrance / Journal officiel (explanatory presentation dated 1 July 2021)
annotation.summary_en: Presentation of French Ordinance 2021-443 setting the criminal liability regime for vehicles with automated driving delegation: the manufacturer is liable when the system is active, usage conditions and takeover/minimal-risk requirements apply, consumers must be informed, and automated road transport systems face safety demonstration rules.
key_provisions_or_claims: Manufacturer or its representative bears criminal liability when the automated driving system is activated
Access to driving-delegation state data for authorities, manufacturer and registration holder
System must alert driver, request takeover, and reach a safe state if takeover fails
Prior consumer information required before sale or rental
Automated road transport systems require safety demonstration; remote intervention only by licensed persons; application tied to Vienna Convention amendment
